strings.app.title: Corner Tasks
strings.settings.cloud.body.on: Tasks on this device will sync to the backend you configured.
strings.settings.cloud.body.off: Cloud sync is off. Your tasks stay on this device.
strings.settings.cloud.body.off.detail: You can stay offline forever. If you decide to enable later, you can either generate a new key (a brand new account) or import an existing key from another device.
strings.settings.cloud.intervalRange: Range: 10 s – 24 h. Applies to both push and pull.
strings.settings.account.title: Account
strings.settings.account.qrScanHint: Scan this with another device to import this account.
strings.settings.account.mnemonicWarn: Treat these 12 words like a password. Anyone with them can read and modify this account's tasks.
strings.settings.account.qrWarn: This QR code encodes the same 12 words as your mnemonic.
strings.settings.account.forgetWarn: This wipes the mnemonic from this browser. Tasks on this device are kept; cloud sync turns off.
strings.settings.appearance.title: Appearance
strings.settings.dock.title: Show icon in Dock
strings.settings.dock.help: Changes apply immediately. The menu bar icon stays visible either way.
strings.settings.debug.title: Debug
strings.settings.debug.warn: These controls are intended for development. Use with care.
strings.settings.qr.scan.title: Scan QR from another device
strings.settings.qr.scan.help: Point your camera at the QR shown by another device to import its account.
